about: {name} is a B2B HR and recruitment consultancy.
description: {name} case study: a recruitment website with separate paths for employers and candidates, plus a LinkedIn ad and a Google search listing.
brief: {name} is an HR and recruitment consultancy. We built its website, with separate paths for employers (a role-brief form) and candidates (an open-roles search).

Two audiences arrive at the same homepage, so it splits them at the top: one card for people who need to hire, one for people looking for work. A LinkedIn ad and a Google search listing carry the same split.

showcases.title: Homepage with employer and candidate paths
showcases.text: Two clear doors on the first screen, a sector strip beneath them, and a phone version that stacks the same two choices.

showcases.title: A role-brief form and an open-roles search
showcases.text: Employers describe the role in a short brief. Candidates search live roles by keyword, location and sector.

showcases.title: A LinkedIn ad and a Google search listing
showcases.text: The LinkedIn ad speaks to employers. The Google listing links to both the employer and the candidate path.
